recipe_version.title: Cheese Chiles Rellenos with Ranchero Sauce and Rice
recipe_version.description: Broiler-blistered poblano chiles stuffed with melting Monterey Jack, dipped in a cloud-light whipped egg batter, and shallow-fried until golden and puffed. Served on a chunky tomato-jalapeño ranchero sauce with cilantro-lime rice and a drizzle of crema.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 3/4 tsp sauce, 3/4 tsp rice, 1/4 tsp egg whites, pinch over the fried chiles

steps.title: Preheat the broiler and prep
steps.body: Set a rack 4 inches below the broiler and turn the broiler on high to preheat for 5 minutes. Dice the onion, mince the garlic and jalapeño, cut the cheese into sticks, separate the eggs, and chop the cilantro.

steps.title: Blister and steam the chiles
steps.body: Broil the poblanos on the sheet pan, turning every 2 to 3 minutes, until blackened and blistered all over, about 10 minutes. Move them to a bowl, cover with a plate, and let them steam 10 minutes.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: While the chiles broil, combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 3/4 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Boil, cover, cook on low 15 minutes, and rest covered. Runs inside steps 2 and 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the ranchero sauce
steps.body: While the chiles steam, heat 2 tbsp oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium. Cook the onion, garlic, and jalapeño 4 minutes. Add the tomatoes, 1/2 cup water, the oregano, and 3/4 tsp salt and simmer, stirring now and then, until thick but spoonable, 8 minutes. Keep warm. Runs inside the steam in step 2 and step 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Peel and stuff
steps.body: Rub the skins off the chiles with your fingers (do not rinse). Cut a slit down one side of each, gently pull out the seed pod, and slide in a cheese stick; close the slit and secure with a toothpick. Dredge each chile in the flour and tap off the excess.

steps.title: Batter and shallow-fry
steps.body: Heat 2 cups oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet to 350 F, about 6 minutes. While it heats, whip the egg whites with 1/4 tsp salt to stiff peaks, then fold in the yolks. Holding each chile by the stem, coat it in batter and lay it in the oil. Shallow-fry in 2 batches of 2 chiles, 2 to 3 minutes per side, spooning oil over the top, until deep golden and puffed. Drain on a rack and sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Remove the toothpicks.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice with the lime zest, lime juice, and half the cilantro. Spoon ranchero sauce onto each plate, set a chile on top, drizzle with crema, scatter the remaining cilantro, and serve with the rice.

equipment: large bowl with a plate to cover
